Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. Hope you enjoyed our coverage of today's match. India after successfully clinching the ODI series will now play the hosts for a single T20I at the same venue. West Indies will look to brush this defeat aside and look to capitalise on the shortest format of the game which begins on 9th July at 1030 local (1530 GMT). Until then, cheers and goodbye!

Man of the Series, Ajinkya Rahane says that he wanted to make it count in the middle. Mentions that he was playing well in the nets in the Champions Trophy as well. Informs that today's wicket was better to bat on than the previous two venues with Antigua being slightly damp and slow. Adds that he wanted to enjoy himself and not put pressure on himself. Ends by saying that ODI cricket is all about converting starts into big scores and expressing yourself.

Indian captain and Man of the Match, Virat Kohli starts by saying that their aim was to win the series and he is delighted to make that happen. Appreciates Ajinkya Rahane and Kuldeep Yadav for their brilliant performances throughout the series. Reckons that he never looks at the stats and he always looks to give his best on the field. Informs that he likes to play according to the tempo of the game and also looks to set it at times. Praises Dinesh Karthik for his fine knock today. Mentions that all the guys are exceptional as they have reached this level after quite some hard work. Adds that captaincy does not burden him much as he still plays the game in a similar manner as he used to when he was not a captain.

West Indian captain, Jason Holder says that they got a very good start with the bat but when Kyle Hope, who was playing really well got out, it set them back and they couldn't recover from it. Adds that they got to learn things as quickly as possible. Mentions that he can control what is in his control and individuals have to step up. He says that he sympathises with the batsman as they are relatively inexperienced but they need to learn quickly and make use of the off season. On the surface in Jamaica, he says that they knew it is good for batting but failed to capitalise on the starts. Ends by saying that their bowling has been a positive for them as apart from one score of conceding 300-plus, they bowled really well in the series.

Ajinkya Rahane and Virat Kohli laid a solid stand, seeing off the new balls. The former could not capitalize on the start he got but the Indian skipper went on to score yet another century while chasing, making him the player with the most number of hundreds batting second. Dinesh Karthik who came in next, scored a fifty of his own and his unbeaten stand with Kohli sealed the deal for India. Series presentation coming up...

India have cruised to yet another victory and have successfully clinched the 5-match ODI series 3-1. After being asked to bowl, the visitors displayed superb skills to restrict the hosts to a below par total. However, West Indies thought elsewise as they looked to recreate the magic of the last match. They started off really well by dismissing Shikhar Dhawan early but after that they lacked intent as the opposition started building up partnerships.

SIX! A fitting end to the series! Finished off with a maximum by the Indian skipper. Full around off, Kohli whips it powerfully over wide long on for a biggie. Leads his side from the front and helps them WIN THE MATCH BY 8 WICKETS!
Kohli turns it with the spin to mid-wicket.
8th ODI fifty for Dinesh Karthik!
Off spinner outside off, Karthik waits for it and then dabs it late to short third man for a single. Gets to his half century, making most of the opportunity presented to him.
Fires it short outside off, punched through cover-point for a single.
Full outside off, Karthik prods forward and milks down to long on for a single.
Roston Chase is brought into the attack.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drifting down the leg side, Karthik gets across and flicks it behind square on the leg side. The square leg fielder has a lot of ground to cover which allows the Indian batsmen to pick up three.
Straying on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Fullish delivery on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Rovman Powell is called into the attack.
Full around off, drilled hard down the track. Williams does well to half-stop it.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
28th ODI century for the Indian skipper Virat Kohli!

FOUR! A record 18th ton in chase in ODIs for Virat Kohli! Take a bow, the Indian skipper! Slower delivery around off, Kohli gets across and whips it through the gap between mid on and mid-wicket. The ball runs to the fence and Kohli celebrates by letting out a huge roar. He is pumped up and so is the dressing room.

NOT OUT! On a length outside off, Kohli looks to play it on the off side but gets a thick inside edge through backward square leg. Runs the first one hard and comes back for the second. Karthik is late to respond. Chase in the deep is alert and hurls a throw at the bowler's end. Williams collects the throw and lobs it towards the stumps. The umpire goes upstairs and the replay shows that Karthik made it just in time to stay alive. Kohli moves to 97 with this!
The umpire has gone upstairs to check for a run out appeal against Dinesh Karthik.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven crisply on the off side. Nurse at short cover, dives to his right and makes an excellent stop to prevent a run.
Defended to covers on the up.

Drinks break! The chase master, the Indian skipper has helped his team take a firm control in the match. India are just 22 runs short of a victory and end seems nigh for the hosts. Kohli seemed to be struggling with cramps and was given stretching from the team physio.

FOUR! Ends the over on a high note! Full on middle, Karthik gets a touch across and flicks it through wide mid on. It's in the same gap as earlier but this time around the timing is better and so the ball runs to the fence.
Back of a length delivery outside off, placed to point.
Wide! Holder goes short but down the leg side this time. Karthik leaves and gets a wide.
Back of a length delivery, Karthik looks to pull it away but doesn't get it off the middle. However, it's in the gap between mid-wicket and mid on and as a result, a brace is taken.
Short and angling in, Kohli rides the bounce and pulls it comfortably to deep backward square leg for a single.
Full around off, Kohli mistimes his drive to mid on.
Full and straight on middle, clipped to long leg for a single.
Angling down leg, worked towards fine leg to keep the strike with the single. Just a run from the over.
Slightly ahead of a length outside off,  dabbed to point.
After two slow deliveries, Williams bowls it quicker outside off. Karthik is early into his shot and only manage to push it to mid off.
Very full outside off, driven to mid off this time.
Very full outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Yorker on the stumps, dug out back to the bowler.

Kohli isn't happy! Back of a length outside off, Kohli dabs it in the short third man region and wants a single. However, seeing the backward point fielder rush to the ball, Karthik sends his skipper back. Kohli gets back in time but gives an unhappy stare to his partner.
Banged in short, VK lets it sail through.
Short outside off, Kohli pulls it crisply through mid-wicket. The sluggish outfield allows the fielder in the deep to cut it off. A brace is taken.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square leg. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shortish outside off, guided to backward point.
Back of a length delivery, glided to third man for a single. Shai Hope after receiving the ball, throws it towards his bowler. However, Holder isn't looking and gets hit on the shoulder.
Slower delivery on the shorter side, dabbed on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Into the nineties! Shortish delivery outside off, Virat Kohli stands tall, rides the bounce well and punches it superbly through covers. The ball reaches the fence this time.
Slower one, full on the stumps, driven dead straight onto the stumps at the non-striker's end.
Again it's bowled behind length and outside off. VK stands tall and punches it on the up through extra cover for a couple.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli throws his bat at it. Gets a bottom-inside edge, which falls short of the keeper, who fumbles and concedes a brace.
Slower delivery on a length outside off. Kohli adjusts well and defends it in the cover region.
Kesrick Williams is brought back for a bowl.
Karthik gets behind the line of the ball and defends it towards the fielder at point.
Good length delivery outside off, Karthik gets an inside edge and the ball rolls away to the keeper.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.

Angling into the stumps, Karthik gets forward and tries to defend it. Gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball lobs on the leg side. The mid-wicket fielder rushes towards it but only manages to catch it on a bounce and then has a shy at the striker's end. He misses but had he hit, it would have been close.
Full and angling into the pads, Kohli clips it towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli defends it towards the fielder at point.
Jason Holder is back into the attack.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. One run added to the total.
Outside off, stays low. Karthik still manages to punch it through covers for a single.
Kohli camps back and punches it towards long on for a single.
Kohli pushes it towards the fielder at point.

FOUR! Freebies! High full toss outside off, Virat Kohli does not miss out on those. He pulls it with disdain over the mid-wicket region for a boundary. The West Indian supporters in the stand are furious seeing such a delivery.
Fuller outside off, Kohli drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Devendra Bishoo is back for a bowl.
FOUR! This time he cuts and cuts really well! Shorter outside off, Karthik waits for it and cuts it through the backward point region for a boundary. Beats two fielders in the process.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Quicker outside off, Karthik goes for the cut. Gets an inside edge which goes past the keeper for a single.
Floats it outside off, Karthik goes for the drive but misses it completely.
Comes around the wicket this time, sprays it short into the pads. Kohli punches it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Beautifully timed! Fuller in line of the stumps, Kohli makes room and drives it crisply through the extra cover region for a boundary.
Bye! Back of a length delivery outside off, the ball stays low. Kohli fails to push it through. The keeper does not collect it and the batsmen run a bye.
Short outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
Kohli shuffles across and clips it towards wide mid on for a single.
Karthik punches it through covers for a single.

FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Karthik slashes hard at it. Gets it through the backward point region. Rovman Powell runs to his right from third man but fails to stop it with a dive. The ball goes to the fence and the bowler is furious.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Was that intentional? If it was then it was sensational. Quicker around off, Kohli plays really late at it. Guides it off the outer half past the keeper. Beats the short third man fielder and the ball races away to the fence. India are cruising towards the target at the moment. This also brings the 50-run stand between Kohli and Karthik.
Fires it into the pads, Kohli flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Karthik camps back and punches it towards long on for a single.
Quicker around middle and leg, Karthik lunges forward and defends it neatly.
Short and wide outside off, Karthik camps back and cuts it through the backward point region for a couple.
Floated outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Fuller outside off, Karthik drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli shuffles a bit and pushes it through the point region for a single.
Kohli shuffles across and clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Short delivery into the batsman, Kohli thinks of the pull shot but lets it through at the last moment.
Karthik stays in his crease and steers it towards third man for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched through covers for a single off the back foot.
Alzarri Joseph is called back for a bowl.
Shorter outside off, Karthik prods forward in defence.
Eased to long on for a single.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Kohli drives it back to the bowler who dives to his right to stop it.
Around leg, Kohli reaches out to it and clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Clipped through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Fuller outside off, Karthik steps out and drives it beautifully through the cover region for a boundary. Such an elegant shot to watch.

SIX! Get that ball says Kohli! Short delivery by Bishoo, Kohli camps back and hammers that over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen. Kohli has had enough of the waiting game. 89 runs needed off 162 balls.
Fuller around off, Kohli digs it out straight back to the bowler.
Shorter outside off, pushed towards covers for a quick single.
Fuller into the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Driven towards long on for a single.
Karthik gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.

FOUR! 44th ODI fifty for Virat Kohli! 10th one against West Indies. Full and wide outside off, Kohli just reaches out to it and drives it elegantly through the cover region for a boundary. Another brilliant knock while chasing and he will look to finish things off.
Sprayed into the pads, nudged towards square leg for a single.
Around middle and off, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, Karthik carves it through covers for a single.
Into the pads, the batsman clips it through the backward square leg region for a couple. 100 up for India.
A bit short outside off, Karthik cuts it late but straight towards the backward point fielder.
Ashley Nurse is called in for a bowl.
Tossed up outside off, Kohli pushes hard at it. Gets a thick outside edge to it and the fielder at short third man dives to his left to stop it.
Shorter outside off, Kohli punches it towards the fielder at covers off the back foot.
Fuller around off, Kohli leans and drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Again short and outside off, Karthik cuts it through covers for a single.
Again flatter outside off, Karthik cuts hard but straight to the fielder at point.
FOUR! Top shot! Short and flatter outside off, Karthik camps back and punches it powerfully through the cover region for a boundary.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Cutter outside off, punched on the up to covers.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, defended to mid-wicket.
Again it's full and angling in. Virat Kohli for the third time in a row shimmies across and flicks it through square leg. A sluggish outfield makes the ball stop near the fence. Three runs taken.
FOUR! Top notch stuff! A slower delivery, full and angling in. Kohli covers his stumps and whips it beautifully over wide mid on for a boundary. This shot is the sign of Kohli's confidence today.
Full and tailing in, Kohli shimmies across and clips it straight to mid-wicket.
Off the mark straightaway! Shortish outside off, spinning away, Karthik cuts it through backward point for a couple.
Dinesh Karthik walks out to the middle. A slip, short leg and a short cover in place for him.

OUT! Bishoo strikes! Rahane looked nervy after the break and this has resulted in his wicket. It is a slider from Bishoo, which Ajinkya fails to pick. He prods forward to defend but gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger straightaway. Ajinkya Rahane fails to register a half century this time around. Can WI land some more blows to the visitors?
Wrong one outside off, Rahane goes back to cut but the ball keeps low and goes in the gloves of the keeper.
Sliding into pads, flicked square of the wicket on the leg side.
Sliding into the pads, Rahane looks to work it on the leg side but is beaten. The ball rolls off the pads on the leg side. Kohli wants to scamper through but Rahane shouts 'no'.
Full on middle and off, driven back to the bowler.
Time for Drinks! India are cruising towards the target in a relatively easy manner. West Indies will need to pick up quick wickets to stop the tempo or else it would be too late.

Back of a length outside off, guided behind square on the off side. Kyle Hope there, dives to his right to prevent a run. Good comeback this, from Williams after conceding a boundary off the first ball.
Pitched outside off, punched to covers.
Back of a length delivery, nudged to mid-wicket.
Slower delivery at 109 kph, Kohli is surprised by the lack of pace and mistimes his punch to covers.
Length delivery, Kohli walks across and tucks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! This had 'Hit me' written all over it. It was going down leg and Kohli just had to get bat on it. He tickles it to the fine leg fence. Good start to the over for India.
Served outside off, guided to short third man for a single.
Full outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
Flatter delivery around off, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
Loopy delivery outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Lucky! Rahane dances down the track, goes for a big heave. Gets an inside edge and the ball runs past the stumps. Even the keeper can't collect it to stump Ajinkya. The short fine leg fielder tries chasing it down but finishes second. Rahane ought to be careful here.
Slower delivery, angling in, defended gently towards mid-wicket.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, slashes it over covers for a single.
Banged in short outside off, Rahane thinks of ramping it over the keeper but then ends up leaving it. Looks to the square leg umpire for a wide but only sees one bouncer being signaled.
Another shortish delivery, glided to third man for a single.
Back of a length delivery, angling down leg. Rahane works it to fine leg for a single.
The wind has picked up and the bails fall in the process. Kesrick Williams was stopped in his run-up by the umpire.
Bishoo drags his length back. Rahane camps back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
A similar delivery and Kohli drives it in the gap in the cover region for a single.
Full outside off, VK drives it off the front foot to covers.
Landed on middle, Kohli leans ahead and blocks it.
Rahane prods forward and pushes the ball with soft hands in the cover region for a single.
Served outside off, spinning away. Kohli waits for it and dabs it late past the slip fielder for a single.
A touch fuller this time, defended to mid on.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched to covers.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. One run added to the total.
Wide outside off, Kohli misses out on it as he slashes it hard but the cover fielder stops it superbly with a dive.

Poor bowling and poor fielding! Williams sprays it down the leg side. Kohli tickles it towards fine leg. The throw from the fielder goes over the keeper's head and the man backing up puts a casual effort, conceding an extra run. A total of two runs added to the total.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Rahane moves in his crease and punches it through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Slightly streaky! Served wide outside off, Kohli flashes hard at it. Gets it off the outer half and the ball runs past the backward point fielder for a boundary. Spoils a good over.
Sliding into the batsman, clipped to mid-wicket.
Full on middle and off, flicked in the mid-wicket region for a single.
Quicker delivery but on the shorter side around off, punched to long on for a single.
Full outside off, driven nicely but straight to the man at short extra cover.
Leg spinner on the shorter side. Rahane goes back and punches it to covers.
Slower one around off, punched down the track to mid on.
50-run stand up between Kohli and Rahane.
Wide outside off, glided to third man for a single. Both the players are ticking along nicely.
Back of a length delivery, slanting in, tucked through backward square leg for a single.
Angling into the batsman, worked to mid on.

Again Williams bowls it on a back of a length outside off. Kohli dabs it off the outer half on the off side and takes off for a quick single. Rahane responds immediately but is lucky to see a shy at his end miss. Had that hit, it would have been very close.
Back of a length delivery outside off, angling in. Guided to third man for a single.
Kesrick Williams is called into the attack.
Served outside off, spinning away, placed to point.
Bishoo keeps it on the shorter side, outside off. Jinx goes back and cuts it through covers for a single.
Another shortish delivery, punched towards covers.
Leg spinner around off, punched off the toe end back to the bowler.
Full around off, driven back to the bowler.
Serves quicker through the air outside off, skids on. Rahane goes back to play but gets beaten and ends up off-balanced as well. Good start this by Bishoo.
Devendra Bishoo is introduced into the attack.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Now a maximum of four fielder are allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli prods forward in defence. A maiden from Holder. 156 runs needed in 240 balls.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Short delivery outside off, dabbed off the back foot towards the fielder at point.
Outside off, Kohli is undisturbed by that line.
Back of a length delivery around off, Kohli defends it back to the bowler.
Drifting into the pads, Kohli clips it towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Slower delivery at a shorter length outside off, Kohli goes way across, rides the bounce and pulls it with grit over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Kohli camps back and defends it.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli drives it towards wide mid off. Holder half-stops it and allows the batsmen to run a couple.
Again outside off on a shorter length, Kohli lets it through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, nipping in. Kohli covers his stumps and lets it through.
Kohli clips it towards square leg for a single.
Outside off, left alone.
Rahane nurdles it through the backward square leg region for a single.
Again short delivery outside off, Rahane thinks of pulling it at first but then thinks otherwise in the last moment.

Pretty close! Short delivery around off, bounces a touch extra which surprises Kohli. Virat still goes to play at it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies towards Ashley Nurse who dives to his right. However, the ball just falls short of him and rolls towards third man. A single is taken.
Fuller delivery outside off, Kohli gets forward to defend it.
Slower delivery outside off, Rahane gets forward and defends it. Another good over for India, 9 runs off it.
Again a short delivery, Kohli clips it through the backward square leg region for a single.
FOUR! It just gets better this time! Again a short ball but stays a bit low. Kohli shuffles across and swivels the pull through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Short into the body, Kohli shuffles across and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli guides it towards the fielder at point.
FOUR! After Rahane, Kohli is now adding up in his pile! Fuller delivery around off, Virat just leans into the drive and drills it through the mid off region for a boundary.
FOUR! Class! Short and around off, Rahane sways back a bit to make room for himself. Then plays the perfect square cut past the point fielder for a boundary. Good over for India, 12 from it!
A bit on the shorter side, Rahane fails to clip it on the leg side. Gets hit on the thigh pad this time.
FOUR! Good shot! Length delivery outside off, Rahane prods a bit forward and flays at it. Gets it through the point region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, nipping away. Rahane tries to poke at it but fails to make contact.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahane pushes it towards the fielder at point.
FOUR! Deft! Sprayed into the pads, Rahane shuffles and tickles it fine past the keeper for a boundary. The fine leg fielder had no chance to reach it.
Short delivery outside off, Kohli stays tall and punches it through the cover region for a couple. 7 runs off the over.
Dug in really short this time outside off, Kohli sits down under the bumper.
Again on a similar length, Rahane gets it past the gully fielder this time for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, dabbed towards the fielder at gully.
FOUR! Simply exquisite! Slower delivery outside off, Rahane shows his class as he just shuffles across and works it beautifully through the wide mid on region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards the fielder at covers.
Length delivery around off, Kohli shuffles across and defends it on the leg side.
Short delivery into the batsman, Virat Kohli ducks under it.
Another back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli is not going to fidget on that corridor.
Short outside off, Kohli lets it through.

Dropped! Short and wide outside off, Rahane slashes hard. The ball rockets towards Bishoo at cover-point. He gets low and to his left, gets both his hands to it but fails to hold onto it. Rahane gets a life just like he got in the last game. A single is taken as well. How costly will this drop prove to be?
Fuller around middle and leg, Rahane clips it beautifully through the mid-wicket region. Beats the diving fielder there and the batsmen run a couple.
Played to mid-wicket by the batsman.
Fuller delivery around off, Virat shuffles and drives it towards the fielder at mid on.
Short delivery outside off, Rahane guides it through the gully region for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Rahane defends it with ease.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Rahane stays in his crease and dabs it towards the fielder at wide slip.
Angling into the pads, Rahane fails to clip it on the leg side. Gets rapped on the thigh pad.
Good length delivery around off, Virat Kohli shuffles across and defends it neatly.
Short delivery into the batsman, Virat Kohli stands tall and clips it through the square leg region for a couple.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli shoulders his arms to it.
Angling into the hips, Kohli shuffles a bit. The ball bounces a bit more than expected and he somehow manages to defend it towards mid-wicket.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahane guides it towards third man for a single.
Rahane gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
Whereas the West Indies skipper Jason Holder to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
The Indian skipper Virat Kohli walks out to bat.

OUT! Dhawan departs! Fuller delivery outside off, Dhawan checks his pushy-drive. Plays a half-hearted shot and the ball goes straight to the fielder at short cover. Evin Lewis is the man there, who makes no mistake. The West Indians are delighted. Perfect start for them. This is another failure for Shikhar Dhawan.
Fuller this time but outside off, Dhawan lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Brilliant! Short delivery outside off, Dhawan slashes hard and gets it through the the third man region for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
Almost chops it on! Short of a length delivery outside off, kicks off from the surface. Rahane looks to defend it late but gets a bottom edge and the ball bounces over the stumps.
Starts it with a delivery outside off, shaping away, Rahane makes a watchful leave.

The players are back for the last innings of the ODI series. As usual it's Ajinkya Rahane and Shikhar Dhawan to open for India. Alzarri Joseph to start the proceedings with the first new ball. He has a slip in place. Here we go...
